parse_fasta_string: parse a FASTA string and return sequences and descriptions as separate lists
lazy_parse_fasta_iterator: lazily iterate over FASTA sequences yielding sequence and description tuples one at a time
convert_a3m_to_stockholm: convert an A3M formatted MSA string into Stockholm format with optional sequence limit
convert_stockholm_to_a3m: convert a Stockholm format MSA file into A3M format with configurable line width
review_parsers_module: review the parsers module functions for FASTA, A3M, and Stockholm format conversion
